objective: Make Rosalind understandable, installable and useful for recurring candidate-SNV research, then build local cohort reanalysis on verified saved evidence.

tasks.acceptance: Researcher/reuse/builder commands pass clean supported native/wheel environments; link/assets/version checks; exclude big archives; behavior tests rather than prose.
